name: EmailFunnelAI: AI Email Marketing, Funnels, Automation & Drip Campaigns for WordPress
author: Ratul Hasan

sections.description:
EmailFunnelAI is the most powerful email marketing plugin for the EmailFunnelAI platform. Automatically sync contacts from WordPress users, comment authors, and WooCommerce orders, then launch AI-driven campaigns, funnels, and forms.

Whether you’re running an eCommerce store, a membership site, or a content blog, EmailFunnelAI bridges the gap between your WordPress audience and professional email marketing automation.

Why EmailFunnelAI for WordPress?

Most email marketing plugins require manual exports, CSV uploads, or expensive third-party Zapier connections. EmailFunnelAI syncs your contacts in real time — automatically and intelligently — so your lists are always up to date.

Key Features

  • 🔄 Real-Time Contact Sync — Automatically sync WordPress users, WooCommerce customers, and comment authors to your EmailFunnelAI contact lists the moment they interact with your site.
  • 🔐 Single Sign-On (SSO) — Access the full EmailFunnelAI platform instantly from your WordPress admin panel with one click — no separate login needed.
  • 📊 Built-In Analytics Dashboard — Monitor funnel performance, campaign results, and form conversions directly inside WordPress — no tab-switching required.
  • 📋 List Management — Create, organize, and manage your email contact lists without leaving WordPress.
  • 🗂️ Custom Field Mapping — Map any WordPress or WooCommerce field (name, role, order value, etc.) to your EmailFunnelAI contact fields for hyper-personalized campaigns.
  • 🏷️ Auto-Tagging — Automatically tag contacts based on their WordPress role, purchase history, form submissions, or page activity for laser-precise segmentation.

Perfect For

  • WooCommerce stores — Sync buyers and abandoned cart leads automatically.
  • Membership sites — Segment contacts by user role or subscription level.
  • Blogs & content sites — Capture and nurture comment authors and newsletter subscribers.
  • Marketing agencies — Manage client contact lists and funnels at scale.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Complete the 3-step setup wizard to connect your WordPress site to your EmailFunnelAI account.
  3. Configure sync rules, field mapping, and auto-tagging.
  4. Your contacts sync automatically — in real time, every time.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 8.2 or higher
  • An active EmailFunnelAI account
  • WooCommerce (optional, for order-based contact sync)

External Services

This plugin connects to the Email Funnel AI platform (emailfunnel.ai) to sync contact data and provide analytics.

What data is sent: WordPress user details, WooCommerce customer and order data, and comment author information — only when a sync event is triggered (user registration, order placement, comment submission).

Service provider: Email Funnel AI
Terms of Service: https://emailfunnel.ai/terms
Privacy Policy: https://emailfunnel.ai/privacy
sections.installation:
Option 1 — WordPress Plugin Directory (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin.
  2. Search for EmailFunnelAI.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Follow the 3-step setup wizard to connect your account.

Option 2 — Manual Upload

  1. Download the plugin .zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the .zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin and complete the setup wizard.

Option 3 — FTP

  1. Upload the email-funnel-ai folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Follow the setup wizard to link your EmailFunnelAI account.
sections.faq:
Do I need an EmailFunnelAI account to use this plugin?

Yes. This plugin connects your WordPress site to the EmailFunnelAI platform. You’ll need an active account to sync contacts and access analytics.

Does this plugin work with WooCommerce?

Yes! EmailFunnelAI automatically syncs WooCommerce customers and order data to your contact lists, enabling powerful eCommerce email automation.

Is contact sync real-time or scheduled?

Contact sync happens in real time. The moment a user registers, places an order, or leaves a comment, their data is pushed to your EmailFunnelAI contact list.

Can I control which contacts get synced?

Yes. You can configure sync rules, field mapping, and auto-tagging to precisely control which contacts are synced and how they are categorized.

Is Single Sign-On (SSO) secure?

Yes. SSO uses encrypted token-based authentication to give you seamless, secure access from WordPress to the EmailFunnelAI platform.
